entry.hops: No wire in the Node test: the registry emits frames to a local onFrame; each frame envelope is recorded whole.
entry.notRun: the daemon transport (the registry's onFrame is a local array); the host is a scripted object (registrations and published lane rows)
entry.runs: DesktopServiceRegistry (init / invoke setVisibleSessions / releaseClient / unsubscribe) with the real createDesktopServiceStateSync adapter over a scripted host, the lifecycle-desktop-service fixture module, and the real snapshot delta decoder

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.compare: per recorded step: the conversations the desktops follow now (Node: the newest registration of the shared host) and each conversation row delivered since the step's frames were cleared, as [conversation, text] in order (Node: one session-state frame per published row; K1: the row's item/completed on the connections that follow the thread); case 1 the acceptance of the restarted desktop's version 1, case 2 the refusal of the late registration. The agent pool frame of case 1 reaches every connection over the app feed and is not a conversation row
replay.entry: In K1 each desktop process is its own connection: its service route (apps/desktop/src/main/protocol/service-route.ts createServiceLane, method 'setVisibleSessions') turns setVisibleSessions(ids, version) into thread/resume and thread/unsubscribe on that connection, fencing a version older than or equal to the newest the process sent (implemented on this branch: Node's desktop-service-state-sync.ts setDeliveryFilter fence); a process that ends closes its connection, which detaches its subscriptions (mixdog-core-session SessionHandle::detach; mixdog-app-server server.rs connection drop). Replay: benchmarks/rust-core/recorders/replay-desktop-visibility-restart.mjs, run by mixdog-core-session src/session/client_chain_replay_tests.rs, which answers it from a SessionDirectory with the product's RecordTranscript (one chain: the route's calls reach the core, the rows the core delivers are read back from each connection).

cases.a restarted desktop can register version: replayed: the ended process's connection closes; the new process's route starts its own counter, so version 1 applies and its conversation's rows reach it
cases.late registrations from a previous deskt: replayed: the ended process has no connection, so its late call is refused and changes no conversation another desktop follows
cases.out-of-order and equal registrations sta: replayed: service-route.ts ignores a version older than or equal to the newest it sent (the fence this branch adds)
cases.unversioned legacy registrations remain: replayed: an unversioned call applies and leaves the counter
cases.concurrent desktops keep independent cou: replayed: one route and connection per desktop process
cases.unsubscribing one desktop retains shared: replayed: a thread's rows reach every connection that still follows it, none once the last has closed
